context: Two cafe friends recap an awkward birthday party
purpose: Teach: 何やら/思い込ん/思い込み/やさしく/今さら/間近/一同/礼儀

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨日のパーティ、何やら最初から空気変だったよね。
lines.en: Yesterday's party felt strange from the very beginning, didn't it?
lines.style: Gently observant opening. Soft, careful tone — noticing without judgment. Slight rise at the end, inviting agreement. The voice of someone checking in on a shared unease.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。皆、お互いに思い込ん感じで、雰囲気がぎこちなかった。
lines.en: Yeah. Everyone was in their own head, second-guessing each other. The whole thing felt stiff.
lines.style: Knowing nod in the voice. Warm but matter-of-fact. Steady pace, no rush — she's seen this before. The reassurance of mutual understanding without needing to belabor it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私の思い込みかもしれないけど、ホスト一同、礼儀正しすぎたよ。
lines.en: Maybe I'm just reading into it, but the hosts seemed almost too formal, didn't they?
lines.style: Hesitant, gentle self-doubt. Checking herself for being unfair. Quiet and thoughtful. The trailing question mark is genuine — she's not convinced of her own reading.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ふふ、緊張してたのかも。今さらだけど、もっとやさしく声かければよかった。
lines.en: Hehe, maybe they were just nervous. And honestly, I wish I'd reached out more gently earlier on.
lines.style: Light, self-aware laugh. Warm but tinged with genuine regret — not performative guilt, real recognition. Slower on the second thought, like she's owning something true about herself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お別れ間近、ようやく皆、笑い合えてたよね。
lines.en: But right at the end, when everyone was saying goodbye — that's when they all finally loosened up and laughed together.
lines.style: Soft warmth building toward the end. Appreciative, almost tender. Breath-easy and present. Like watching something small and good happen, and wanting to mark that it happened.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、終わりよければすべて良し。
lines.en: Yeah, exactly. It ended well — that's what matters.
lines.style: Quiet completion. Simple, at-peace tone. Slight smile underneath. The close of a conversation where both people understand something without needing more words.
